text.inline:
The fix worked. The `page_count` function was using floor division (`//`) which gives 2 for 21//10, but pagination requires ceiling division - you need an extra page for any remainder items. I changed it to `(total_items + per_page - 1) // per_page` which is the standard ceiling division trick in Python.

The test now passes: 21 items with 10 per page correctly returns 3 pages.
